privacy.pdpa_intro: This app is designed to be privacy-first. All your personal health information is stored exclusively on your device and is not shared with any third party.
privacy.pdpa_collection_text: We store your medication schedules, dose history, and vital signs that you manually enter or scan. This data remains on your phone.
privacy.pdpa_usage_text: Your data is used solely to provide you with reminders, track your adherence, and display your health trends. We do not use it for any other purpose.
privacy.pdpa_storage_text: Your data is stored in an encrypted format on your device. If you uninstall the app, all your data will be permanently deleted.
privacy.pdpa_rights_text: You have the right to access, modify, and delete your data at any time from within the app settings.
privacy.pdpa_consent_text: I have read, understood, and agree to the terms of this privacy notice.
privacy.pdpa_required_notice: This consent is required to use the app.

risk.title: Risk Factors
risk.subtitle: Toggle the cards below to capture your key diabetes risk factors.
risk.age_hint: Adults aged 45 and above have a higher risk of developing type 2 diabetes.
risk.gender_hint: Men may develop type 2 diabetes slightly earlier. Toggle to "Yes" if you were assigned male at birth.
risk.smoking_hint: Smoking increases insulin resistance and the risk of complications.
risk.bp_hint: High blood pressure often accompanies insulin resistance. Toggle "Yes" if you take BP medicines.
risk.bmi_unknown: Add your weight & height to calculate BMI.
risk.bmi_hint: A BMI of 27.5 or above (Asian standard) indicates higher metabolic risk.
risk.history_hint: Toggle "Yes" if you have ever been told you have high blood sugar or pre-diabetes.
risk.activity_hint: Aim for at least 4 hours of moderate activity weekly. Toggle "Yes" if you meet the goal.
risk.vegetables_hint: Toggle "Yes" if you eat vegetables every day. A balanced diet lowers your risk.
risk.family_hint: Immediate family (parents, siblings) with diabetes raises your risk the most.
risk.results_hint: Scores update automatically when you revise your data.
risk.inputs_section_subtitle: Review each factor below and adjust it to match your current health.
risk.hero_subtitle: Review your health profile and keep your inputs up to date.

errors.bmi_invalid: Weight must be 25-220 kg and height 50-200 cm (BMI 10.0-50.0).

risk_calculators.title: Risk Calculators
risk_calculators.subtitle: Enable the risk calculators you want to track. We will guide you through the required inputs.
risk_calculators.findrisc_desc: Finnish Diabetes Risk Score. Estimates 10-year diabetes risk from lifestyle and body measurements.
risk_calculators.framingham_desc: Simplified Framingham-inspired cardiovascular risk score based on blood pressure, weight and smoking.
risk_calculators.results_hint: Scores refresh automatically when you update your risk factors or log new measurements.
risk_calculators.findrisc_low_desc: Very low probability of developing type 2 diabetes in the next 10 years.
risk_calculators.findrisc_moderate_desc: Slightly elevated risk. Maintain healthy habits and monitor yearly.
risk_calculators.findrisc_high_desc: High risk. Discuss prevention strategies with your healthcare provider.
risk_calculators.findrisc_very_high_desc: Very high risk. Seek medical advice for further assessment.
risk_calculators.framingham_low_desc: Low cardiovascular risk. Continue healthy lifestyle habits.
risk_calculators.framingham_moderate_desc: Moderate cardiovascular risk. Consider lifestyle optimisation.
risk_calculators.framingham_high_desc: High cardiovascular risk. Consult healthcare provider for assessment.
risk_calculators.framingham_very_high_desc: Very high cardiovascular risk. Seek immediate medical advice.
